title: Standalone exact-Hupsel generated-provider selection and lifetime seam
purpose: Prepare the exact M1-C3 whole-Hupsel application gate without regenerating generated-MvG tables inside Task2 trial/retry calls and without changing the analytical default route.

prerequisite.required: F-TAB02-G bounded Hupsel F-SI39 extension PASS

authority.application_route: legacy file/application processing -> M1-C3 typed SoilWater Task2 seam -> Reference Richards
authority.current_gap: mod_b110_production_soil_water_task2 binds b110_default_mvg_provider_t directly; F-TAB02 generated-provider selection currently exists in the serialized FMR backend, not this exact standalone M1-C3 application seam.

frozen_design.default_route: analytical MvG remains default and unchanged
frozen_design.selection: explicit opt-in qualification/application composition control; never infer generated selection from SWSOPHY=0 or from KSATEXM presence
frozen_design.standalone_scope: Use the existing standalone_worker lifetime only for the exact standalone M1-C3 gate.
frozen_design.generated_state_lifetime: Materialize once per exact immutable hydraulic parameter authority and reuse across Task2 attempts/accepted intervals; never generate inside a nonlinear solve or retry hot loop.
frozen_design.cache_semantics: Immutable numerical representation only; no committed physical state, transaction state, retry state or accepted-state memory.
frozen_design.invalidation: Exact parameter-authority mismatch invalidates/rebuilds before use; no tolerance-based cache identity.
frozen_design.multiswap: Do not introduce module-global generated selection for worker/MultiSWAP. Existing FMR typed selection remains the authority outside the standalone exact-Hupsel qualification seam.
frozen_design.output: Legacy file/output path remains unchanged so result.bal/result.blc can be compared to M1-C3 authority.

allowed_production_delta: bounded standalone selection/cache helper if needed
qualification-only entry/harness that opts in generated acceleration before the unchanged legacy application loop
forbidden: automatic generated selection for all M1-C3 runs
coarse-sand expansion as an admission prerequisite

gates.F0_1: Analytical default remains bit/route-preserved with opt-in disabled.
gates.F0_2: Opt-in exact Hupsel M1 profile binds generated provider with F-TAB02-G KSATEXM semantics.
gates.F0_3: Generated table state generation count is one for unchanged exact parameter authority across multiple Task2 calls/retries.
gates.F0_4: Parameter mutation invalidates or rejects cache deterministically; unsupported neighbor material fails closed.
gates.F0_5: No generated state is stored in committed physical state or transaction snapshots.
gates.F0_6: Only after F0_1..F0_5 PASS may the exact whole-Hupsel F gate execute.

required_outputs: result.bal and result.blc comparison against exact M1-C3 authority after only the already-authorized Generated-at normalization
